subject.title: Dashboard: preview widget — embed a live URL with reload + viewport controls

question: After the code and proof blockers are fixed, should OpenClaw accept a trusted dashboard preview iframe as a bundled dashboard feature in this stack?
rationale: The change adds a trusted web preview surface and currently rides on a larger dashboard plugin/dependency stack, so automation cannot decide the product and security boundary on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Hold for repaired security review
options.body: Require the binding fix, proof, conflict resolution, and dependency-graph approval or restack before deciding whether to merge the trusted preview surface.

options.title: Narrow the branch
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that depends on an already-landed dashboard substrate and contains only the preview renderer, schema registration, tests, and i18n.

options.title: Decline bundled preview for now
options.body: Close or pause the PR if maintainers do not want a bundled trusted iframe preview surface until the broader dashboard roadmap is accepted.

recommendation.title: Hold for repaired security review
recommendation.body: Require the binding fix, proof, conflict resolution, and dependency-graph approval or restack before deciding whether to merge the trusted preview surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is a product/security boundary decision around the existing Control UI embed policy that steipete recently touched.
